releaseNotes: Secondary schools get their own console. Pick Secondary school in School Setup and the console runs Senior 1 to Senior 6 only: O-Level S1-S4 and A-Level S5-S6 in the level switch, dashboard, classes, students, subjects, teachers, marks, timetable and reports. Primary schools see P1-P7 only, combined schools keep both. Nothing is deleted when you switch. The DeryCode logo now sits inside the console: sidebar, setup wizard and PIN lock screen.
